DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書のご相談と伺いました。何を証明する書類でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you would like advice about a certificate. What would the document certify?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社から事故の証明を出すように言われました。自転車で転んだ件ですが、書類の名前がわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社の曖昧な証明要求を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My company told me to submit proof of an accident. It concerns falling off my bicycle, but I do not know the document's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your company's vague request for proof. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 事故について警察に届け出たことはありますか。まず状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you reported the accident to the police? Let us first check the circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先週、一人で転びました。届け出はしていません。今から申請すれば証明が出るのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 単独転倒と未届出を明かす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I fell by myself last week. I have not reported it. If I apply now, will a certificate be issued?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Disclose that you fell alone and have not reported it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで今すぐ交付できるとは申し上げられません。会社が求める書類の正式名称も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I cannot say we can issue one here immediately. We also need the official name of the document your company wants.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社のメールを見たら、事故状況の報告書と書いてあります。警察の証明とは書いていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: メールの正式文言を読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Looking at the company's email, it says "report on the circumstances of the accident." It did not say a police certificate.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reread the email's exact wording. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら会社独自の報告用紙かもしれません。提出先に、警察の書類が必要なのか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then it may be the company's own report form. Ask the recipient whether a police document is required.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社へ電話して、指定用紙の有無と警察の書類が必要かを聞きます。事故の日時も整理したほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定用紙と警察書類の必要性を確認する方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will call my company and ask whether there is a designated form and whether a police document is needed. I should also organize the accident date and time.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check for a designated form and whether police documents are needed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ご自身が覚えている日時と場所を整理し、不明な部分を推測で埋めないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Organize the date, time, and location as you remember them, and do not fill unknown parts with guesses.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず会社に確認します。警察への相談が必要とわかったら、確認した書類名を持って改めて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出先確認後の再相談を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check with my company first. If I find that I need to consult the police, I will return with the confirmed document name.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to consult again after checking with the recipient. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 会社の指定を確かめてから、必要ならまたご相談ください。足元にお気をつけて、お帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Check your company's requirements first, then consult us again if needed. Watch your step on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのリュックを二つ並べてご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to look at these two backpacks side by side?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。毎日パソコンを持って通勤するので、見た目より軽さを重視しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: パソコン通勤と軽さの優先を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, please. I commute with a laptop every day, so lightness matters more to me than appearance.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you commute with a laptop and prioritize lightness. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 薄いほうは軽いですが、内側にパソコン用の仕切りがありません。もう一つにはクッション付きの仕切りがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The thinner one is light but has no internal laptop divider. The other has a padded compartment.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 重いほうも背負ってみたいです。予算は八千円以内ですが、値札の六千五百円は税込みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 試着と税込価格を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to try the heavier one on too. My budget is within eight thousand yen; does the six-thousand-five-hundred-yen price include tax?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to try it on and ask whether the price includes tax. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この展示品の値札は税込みです。試着の際は、中にこの重さの見本を入れてみましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The price tag on this display item includes tax. Shall we put this sample weight inside when you try it?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、実際の荷物に近い重さで試したいです。肩ひもを少し長くしてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重りと肩ひもの調整を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I want to try it with a weight close to my actual belongings. Could you make the shoulder straps a little longer?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a sample weight and shoulder-strap adjustment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: これくらいでしょうか。背中に隙間ができすぎないかも確認してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: About this long? Please also check that there is not too much space between the backpack and your back.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この長さなら肩が楽です。ただ、雨の日に使えるか、素材の表示を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 背負い心地と素材表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This length is comfortable on my shoulders. But I would like to see the material label to check whether I can use it on rainy days.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check how it feels on your back and the material label. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが素材表示です。防水と書かれていないので、雨を完全に防ぐとはご案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the material label. It does not say waterproof, so we cannot describe it as keeping rain out completely.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、クッション付きのほうを選び、雨には別のカバーを使います。この商品をレジへ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: クッション付き商品と別の雨対策を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will choose the padded one and use a separate rain cover. I will take this item to the register.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the padded product and separate protection from rain. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お忘れ物にお気をつけて。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please make sure you leave nothing behind. See you.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about this product?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日ここで買った牛乳です。袋を開けたら底がぬれていて、未開封のまま持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未開封商品の漏れを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is milk I bought here yesterday. When I opened the shopping bag, the bottom was wet, so I brought the milk back unopened.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a leak from an unopened product. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入時の状態を確認したいので、レシートと商品を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: To check the condition at purchase, could you show me the receipt and product?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: レシートはあります。買ってからすぐ冷蔵庫に入れ、飲んではいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシートと冷蔵保管状況を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the receipt. I put it in the refrigerator immediately after buying it and have not drunk it.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and describe refrigerated storage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。容器の底から漏れているようですね。交換や返金の対応を担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. It seems to be leaking from the bottom of the container. I will check with the person in charge about replacement or refund options.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族にも飲ませていません。持ち帰る途中で袋に入っていたほかの商品もぬれていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲用していないことと他商品への影響を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not let my family drink it either. Other products in the bag were wet too while I was taking them home.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that nobody has drunk it and describe the effect on other products. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も担当者に伝えます。ぬれた商品の名前と状態がわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass that on as well. Can you tell me the names and condition of the wet products?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 食パンの外袋だけがぬれました。中身に漏れたかは判断できません。食べずに置いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食パンの確認不能な状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only the outer bag of the sliced bread was wet. I cannot judge whether it leaked inside. I have left it uneaten.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the condition of the bread that you cannot fully assess. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。牛乳はこちらでお預かりしてよろしいですか。担当者から対応内容をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. May we hold onto the milk here? The person in charge will explain what we can do.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、預けます。返金か交換かが決まるまで、レシートは手元に持って待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品を預け対応決定を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please take it. I will wait with the receipt in hand until it is decided whether this will be a refund or replacement.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave the product and wait for a decision on the response. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご不便をおかけしました。確認してまいりますので、いったん失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am sorry for the inconvenience. I will check, so please excuse me for a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お引っ越しに関するお手続きですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here for moving-related procedures?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 他県から来て、先週から住んでいます。転入と健康保険の相談をしたいのですが、同じ窓口ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転入と保険の相談窓口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came from another prefecture and have lived here since last week. I want to discuss moving-in registration and health insurance. Is it the same counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the counters for moving-in registration and insurance advice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 転入の受付を確認した後、保険担当へご案内します。前の市区町村で転出の手続きは済ませましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: After checking moving-in registration, we will guide you to the insurance staff. Have you completed moving-out procedures in your previous municipality?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: オンラインで申請しました。受付完了の画面はありますが、紙の証明書はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: オンライン転出と紙書類なしを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: I applied online. I have the completion screen but no paper certificate.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain online moving-out registration and the absence of paper documents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その方法で必要な確認内容を担当に照会します。本人確認できるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the person in charge what needs to be checked for that method. Do you have identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 在留カードとマイナンバーカードを持っています。新しい住所を書いた賃貸契約書もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参した本人確認と住所資料を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my residence card and My Number card. I also have the rental contract showing my new address.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the identification and address documents you brought. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず転入の担当にお見せください。保険は勤務先で加入しているかどうかで相談内容が変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show them first to the moving-in staff. Insurance advice depends on whether you are enrolled through your employer.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事は来週からで、会社の保険に入る日はまだ確認できていません。そのことも保険担当に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務開始と保険加入日未確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I start work next week and have not yet confirmed when I will join the company's insurance. I will tell the insurance staff that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say when work starts and that the insurance enrollment date is unconfirmed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。こちらで加入日を決めることはできませんので、会社にも確認していただく必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We cannot decide the enrollment date here, so you will also need to check with your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は転入の受付を先に済ませ、保険の相談では未確認の加入日を正直に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 転入を先に行う順序を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will complete moving-in registration first, then honestly explain during the insurance consultation that the enrollment date is unconfirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to handle moving-in registration first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、転入の受付へご案内します。お気をつけて、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will guide you to moving-in reception. Take care as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知をお持ちいただいたのですね。どの部分がわかりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought a notice. Which part do you not understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給与から税金が引かれているのに、この通知にも金額があります。同じ税金を二度払うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与控除と通知の重複を疑問として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tax is already deducted from my salary, yet this notice also shows an amount. Am I paying the same tax twice?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Raise a question about possible overlap between payroll deductions and the notice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず通知の表題と発行元を見ましょう。お客様のお名前以外は伏せていただいて構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us first look at the notice's title and issuer. You may cover everything except your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表題は住民税で、発行元は市です。給与明細には所得税と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知と給与明細の税名を読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: The title says resident tax, and the issuer is the city. My payslip says income tax.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the tax names on the notice and payslip. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名称が異なるので、同じ税を二重に払っているとはまだ判断できません。この通知の詳細は発行元の担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: The names are different, so we cannot yet conclude that you are paying the same tax twice. Let us check this notice's details with the issuer's staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 違いがわかりました。ただ、通知の納期限までに全額払うのが難しいので、支払いの相談先も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 支払い困難と相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand the difference. But it will be difficult to pay the full amount by the due date, so I would also like to know whom to consult about payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain payment difficulty and ask whom to consult. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通知に記載された市の担当へ、金額の確認と支払い相談の両方をお伝えください。私が減額や分割を約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell the city staff listed on the notice that you want both to check the amount and discuss payment. I cannot promise a reduction or installments.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話するとき、通知番号と納期限を手元に置けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話に備える資料を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: When I call, should I keep the notice number and due date at hand?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the documents to prepare for the call. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。給与明細も用意して、何が不明なのか説明すると伝わりやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Having your payslip ready too and explaining what is unclear will help them understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日、市の担当へ連絡します。納期限を過ぎるまで何もしないのは避けたいので、まず相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 期限前に発行元へ相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will contact the city staff today. I do not want to do nothing until the due date has passed, so I will seek advice first.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to consult the issuer before the deadline. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご自身で確認する項目が整理できましたね。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have organized what to check yourself. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 注文前に材料を確認されたいと伺いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you want to check ingredients before ordering.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 卵アレルギーがあります。卵をのせなければ食べられる料理か、先に調べていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 卵アレルギーと材料確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an egg allergy. Could you first check whether this is a dish I can eat if the egg topping is left off?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your egg allergy and ask for an ingredient check. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 仕上げだけでなく、生地やソースにも含まれる可能性があります。厨房に原材料を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: Egg may be in the batter or sauce, not only the topping. I will check the ingredients with the kitchen.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 生地にも入ることがあるのですね。同じ鉄板で卵を焼く場合、混ざる可能性も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 共用鉄板の混入可能性を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it may be in the batter too. I also want to know about possible cross-contact if eggs are cooked on the same griddle.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about possible cross-contact on a shared griddle. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この架空の店では鉄板と道具を共用しています。卵を使わない注文でも、付着を完全に避ける保証はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this fictional restaurant, the griddle and utensils are shared. Even an order without egg cannot be guaranteed completely free from contact with it.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 少量でも症状が出たことがあるので、保証できないなら今回は注文しないほうがよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 少量反応と料理を見合わせる判断を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have had symptoms from even small amounts, so if that cannot be guaranteed, it seems better not to order food this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain reactions to small amounts and your decision not to order food. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。食べられると断言せず、原材料の表示だけならお見せできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I cannot state that it is safe for you to eat, but I can show you the ingredient labeling.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示は確認したいです。同行者は食事をしますが、私は密封された飲み物だけにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 密封飲料の選択肢を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to check the labeling. My companion will eat, but may I have only a sealed drink?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the option of a sealed drink. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 用意している飲み物の表示をご覧ください。その商品を選ぶかどうかは、表示を確認して判断してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look at the labels of the drinks we have available. Decide whether to choose a product after checking its label.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この水なら表示を確認できました。私は水だけにして、料理の注文は同行者に任せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示確認後に水だけを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the labeling on this water. I will have only water and leave the food order to my companion.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose only water after checking its labeling. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。どうぞ無理なさらず。いったん失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please do not push yourself. Excuse me for a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の前に、伝票を確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you check the bill before paying?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: つけ麺を一杯頼んだのに、二杯と書かれています。同行者はまだ何も注文していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 注文一杯と伝票二杯の不一致を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I ordered one bowl of dipping noodles, but it says two bowls. My companion has not ordered anything yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the mismatch between one bowl ordered and two on the bill. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 調理担当の私が注文票を照合します。厨房には一杯分だけ通っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: As the cook, I will compare the order slip. Only one bowl was sent through to the kitchen.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、伝票だけの間違いでしょうか。まだ来ていない二杯目の代金まで払うのは困ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二杯目の請求を疑問として確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then is it only a mistake on the bill? I do not want to pay for a second bowl that has not even arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Question and confirm the charge for a second bowl. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: レジ担当に一杯へ訂正するよう伝えます。訂正後の伝票をお持ちしますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the cashier to correct it to one bowl. Please wait here while I bring the corrected bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。辛さを変えて追加注文した扱いになっていないかも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 辛さ変更が追加扱いでないか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Please also check that the change in spiciness was not treated as an additional order.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether a spiciness change was treated as an extra order. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更の記録はありますが、追加の記録ではありません。レジ担当からも一杯の金額で確認できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a record of a change, but not an additional order. The cashier has also confirmed the price for one bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 訂正された伝票は一杯になっています。このまま現金で払うには、レジへ行けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 訂正数量と現金会計の場所を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: The corrected bill now says one bowl. To pay in cash, should I go to the register?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the corrected quantity and where to pay in cash. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、お支払いはレジ担当が承ります。この訂正済みの伝票を渡してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, the cashier will take payment. Please hand over this corrected bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この伝票を持ってレジに行きます。領収書もそちらでお願いすることにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 伝票をレジへ持参し領収書を頼む方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take this bill to the register. I will ask for a receipt there too.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will take the bill to the register and request a receipt there. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お手数をおかけしました。ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sorry for the trouble. Thank you, and please have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 皆様のご注文を伺います。取り分けるお料理から決めましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I take everyone's orders? Shall we start with dishes to share?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 四人ですが、一人は車を運転します。酒を使った料理も避けたいと言っているので、調理方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 運転者の酒使用回避希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are four of us, but one person is driving. They also want to avoid dishes made with alcohol, so I would like to know the cooking methods.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the driver wants to avoid dishes using alcohol. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この煮込みには調理酒を使っています。加熱後の残り具合をここで断言することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: This stew uses cooking sake. We cannot state here exactly how much remains after heating.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら煮込みは注文しません。焼き野菜には酒や酒入りのたれを使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 煮込みを断り焼き野菜の調味料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then we will not order the stew. Do the grilled vegetables use alcohol or a sauce containing alcohol?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decline the stew and ask about seasonings for the grilled vegetables. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 厨房に確認しました。今回の焼き野菜は塩と油で調理し、たれは添えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: I checked with the kitchen. This time, the grilled vegetables are cooked with salt and oil, with no sauce on the side.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それを二皿お願いします。運転する人の飲み物は水にして、他の三人の注文とは分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 焼き野菜数量と運転者の水を注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two plates of that, please. The driver will have water, and I will state that separately from the other three people's orders.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Order the quantity of grilled vegetables and water for the driver. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 焼き野菜二皿と水ですね。ほかの方の飲み物はいかがなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Two plates of grilled vegetables and water, correct? What would the others like to drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ビールを二つ、ウーロン茶を一つください。水は運転する人の席に置いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残り三人の飲み物と水の配膳先を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two beers and one oolong tea. Could you put the water at the driver's seat?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify the other three people's drinks and where the water should be served. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。どちらのお席でしょうか。置き間違えないよう確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Which seat is that? I will check so it is not put in the wrong place.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口に近い青い上着の人です。料理は二皿、飲み物は全部で四人分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 座席の目印と総数量を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: The person in the blue jacket near the entrance. There are two plates of food and drinks for four people in total.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the seat's identifying feature and total quantities. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。席を確認してお持ちします。では、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check the seat and bring them. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 参拝のご案内でしょうか、それとも授与所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need guidance for worship, or are you looking for the religious-items office?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先に参拝してから御朱印をお願いしたいです。参拝の列と御朱印の列は別でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 参拝と御朱印の列の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to worship first, then request a sacred seal. Are the worship queue and sacred-seal queue separate?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between the worship and sacred-seal queues. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用の配置では別々です。まず右側の参拝列へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this learning layout, they are separate. First join the worship queue on the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右側ですね。御朱印帳を家に忘れたので、書き置きがあるかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帳面を忘れ書き置きの有無を問う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the right, understood. I forgot my sacred-seal book at home, so I would also like to know whether prewritten sheets are available.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you forgot your book and ask about prewritten sheets. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本日の扱いは授与所でご確認ください。私の所では在庫や受付終了を確約できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check today's arrangements at the religious-items office. I cannot guarantee stock availability or whether reception has closed from here.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。参拝中は電話をしまって、終わってから授与所で聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話をしまい参拝を先にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will put my phone away during worship and ask at the office afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will put your phone away and worship first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その際、通路で立ち止まらず、案内表示の前で列の行き先を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: When doing so, do not stop in the walkway; check where the queue leads in front of the signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 列が混んでいたら、今日は御朱印をあきらめても構いません。受付中かだけ先に確認してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 混雑時の断念と受付状況確認を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the queue is crowded, I do not mind giving up on the sacred seal today. May I first check just whether requests are still being accepted?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss giving up if crowded and checking whether reception is open. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 授与所の案内表示をご覧ください。不明なら列を遮らない位置から担当者にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: Look at the office's information signs. If unclear, ask the person in charge from a position that does not obstruct the queue.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 参拝を先に済ませ、表示を見てから判断します。無理に列を横切らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示確認と列を遮らない行動を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will worship first, then look at the signs and decide. I will make sure not to force my way across the queue.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to check the signs and avoid obstructing the queue. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ穏やかにお参りください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please worship peacefully. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 明日のご来園についてのお問い合わせですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about visiting the park tomorrow, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。足元が悪いと歩くのが難しい家族がいます。雨でも歩きやすい道があるか聞きたくて電話しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族の歩行事情と雨天経路を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. A family member finds it hard to walk when the ground is poor. I called to ask whether there are paths that are easy to walk on even in rain.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your family member's walking needs and ask about rainy-day routes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 舗装された区間でも、雨で滑りやすくなることがあります。園内の状況は当日の担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even paved sections may become slippery in rain. The staff on duty will check the park's condition on the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今の段階では安全に歩けると決まっていないのですね。朝に状況を確かめるには、どこへ連絡すればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 当日の状態の問い合わせ先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it has not been established at this point that we can walk safely. Whom should I contact to check conditions in the morning?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whom to contact about conditions on the day. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この電話で入口の担当につなぐことができます。お問い合わせの際には、段差を避けたいこともお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can connect you to the entrance staff through this phone number. When asking, also mention that you want to avoid steps.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうします。もし雨が強ければ延期したいのですが、今日は入園予約をしていないので、取り消すものはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約なしと延期の可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will. We might postpone if the rain is heavy, but we have not booked admission, so there is nothing to cancel.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that there is no reservation and you may postpone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予約がないことは承りました。別の日にする場合も、その日の利用案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: I understand there is no reservation. Even if you choose another day, check the visitor information for that day.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日朝にもう一度電話するか、晴れた日に変えるか、今夜家族と相談します。現在の利用時間は案内にも載っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族との相談と最新利用時間の確認を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: Tonight I will discuss with my family whether to call again tomorrow morning or change to a sunny day. Are current opening hours also shown in the information?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will discuss with family and check current opening hours. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内の日時をご確認ください。変更のお知らせが出ていることもあるので、古い画像だけで判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the information's date and time. Changes may be announced, so do not judge from an old image alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。家族にはまだ出発を約束せず、最新の案内と朝の状況を確認してから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出発を確約せず当日判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not promise my family that we are leaving yet; we will decide after checking the latest information and the morning conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not commit to departure and will decide on the day. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご連絡ありがとうございました。ご家族にもよろしくお伝えください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for contacting us. Please give my regards to your family. Goodbye.
